verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI running locally with a built-in chat UI. Its `local-ai chat` shell agent can read files on your machine behind an approval gate, but that is agentic tool use, not automatic retrieval-augmented generation. Nothing in the pack documents document ingestion, embeddings, vector indexing or automatic retrieval over a user's documents, so the applicable RAG axis has no direct support.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation
